summary: This week, Copilot comes to JetBrains Air and Xcode’s coding assistant, with updates to help you manage pull requests, settings, and agent sessions. GitHub Copilot app Set up Agent Merge directly from a pull request to have Copilot merge it when it’s ready.
takeaways: GitHub Copilot app Set up Agent Merge directly from a pull request to have Copilot merge it when it’s ready.
GitHub Copilot CLI Manage your whole setup in one place. /settings now opens a unified dashboard for your plugins, MCP servers, and more, and you can search across all of your settings.
GitHub Copilot in Xcode You can now work with GitHub Copilot directly in Xcode’s built-in coding assistant, bringing Copilot into your native Xcode workflow.
